baseline_scope.hard_gate_definition: Evaluable from the final current-state condition without requiring superseded or ephemeral history. This may use final active semantic memories and/or global no-invention, clarification, precedence, or no-hit behavior. Hard-gate status does not imply that an LTM retrieval hit is strictly required.
baseline_scope.diagnostic_history_definition: Requires historical occurrence/order information and/or superseded or ephemeral context not guaranteed by the final active snapshot.

headline_scope.hard_gate_micro: Micro accuracy over hard_gate=true QA only.
headline_scope.hard_gate_macro_scenario: Macro scenario accuracy over hard_gate=true QA only.

required_metrics.name: micro_accuracy
required_metrics.definition: Correct QA / evaluated QA within selected tier.

required_metrics.name: macro_scenario_accuracy
required_metrics.definition: Average scenario-group accuracy with equal scenario weight.

retrieval_scoring_global_contract.abstention_no_hit_rule: QA with no relevant memory and `no_hit_fpr_eligible=true` belongs to the no-hit FPR bucket.

nonexclusive_support_only_rule.supporting_memory_precision: supporting memories remain precision-relevant and are not false positives

precedence_contract.rule: A more specific current instruction overrides a remembered durable default without rewriting the durable memory unless the user explicitly makes the change persistent.

clarification_scoring_contract.semantic_requirement: Ask for the missing KPI family/context rather than guessing between lexical-near-duplicate subscriber metrics.

qa_execution_context_contract.cross_session_default: Each QA recall case starts in a fresh evaluation session unless the case/run configuration explicitly defines a recent seed.
qa_execution_context_contract.recent_only_rule: Recent messages must be explicitly seeded by the run; prior synthetic sessions must not be concatenated implicitly.
qa_execution_context_contract.recent_plus_ltm_rule: Use exactly the same explicit recent seed as recent_only, then add LTM.

retrieval_ltm_only.purpose: Measure LTM retrieval without recent-context help.

evaluation_modes.ltm_uplift_definition: Compare recent+LTM against recent-only using the exact same recent seed.
